 Court No. - 14
 Hon'Ble Shree Prakash Singh, J. 
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.
2. Instant application has been filed with a prayer to set-aside the impugned summoning order dated 29.07.2024 in Crl. Case No. 33829 of 2024 in Case Crime No. 357 of 2022 u/s 498A, 504 of IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act and 3/4 of the Muslim Women(Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019 P.S. Majhila District Hardoi and to set aside the entire proceedings of case no. 33829 of 2024 arising out of case crime no. 357 of 2022.
3.

entities.text: Muslim Women(Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is argued by learned counsel appearing for the applicants submits that the matter is arising out of matrimonial dispute and initially a complaint was instituted by the informant/opposite party no.2 and thereafter, summons were issued and the applicants applied for bail and they have been granted bail.

He argued that on same set of facts, the instant first information report (FIR) has been lodged,
thereafter, the Investigating Officer, ignoring the fact that a complaint is already running for the same set of allegations, has filed the chargesheet and the Magistrate has also taken cognizance on the aforesaid, erroneously, while ignoring the provision of section 198 of Cr.P.C.

He has drawn attention of this Court towards the order impugned dated 29.07.2024, wherein, while summoning the accused for offence u/s 498A, 504, and 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and3/4 of the Muslim Women(Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, has also summoned u/s 494 of the IPC, which can run as a complaint case.

entities.text: Muslim Women(Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He added that the whole proceedings initiated against the applicants vitiates in the eyes of law, therefore, the proceeding against the applicants maybe quashed.

4. Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the contentions aforesaid, but he could not dispute the settled legal proposition of law and the provision of law as prescribed under section 198 of Cr.P.C.
5.
Prima facie, there seems to be force in the argument of counsel for the applicants, thus, matter requires consideration.

6. Let notice be issued to opposite party no. 2, returnable at an early date.
7. Steps be taken within a week.
8.
If steps are taken, office shall proceed accordingly.

9. List/put up this matter in the week commencing 27.10.2025.
10.
In the meantime, the State as well as opposite party no. 2 may file their counter affidavits.
